snippet.title: Russian Village Business - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Russian Village Business, a shopkeeper simulation game developed by 3D Cube Games. Players will run a local village shop in the Russian countryside to live out the entrepreneurial life. Sell goods, upgrade the shop, and provide fair commerce in Russian Village Business, coming soon to PC (Steam) with a playtest starting on March 27.
